title: Montserrat tour, 10:15 AM
text: Very interesting afternoon tour to Montserrat incl. Arrival by rack railway. Fortunately, the clouds cleared up, and the view was excellent afterward. The virtual tour requires time. Impressive panorama on the return trip. Our guide Ivan kept us well informed. Thanks also for the restaurant tip, Mussol.

title: Better that 5 Stars!!!
text:
Just excellent!!! Our tour guide Anna and driver Blanco gave us a wonderful experience.  

Anna was so informative and excited to share this tour with us.  She assisted in getting into the Basilica early to see the Black Madonna early which gave us more time to explore the area.   

If I could give more the 5 stars I would.  

So glad we went o this tour.
author: GregoryW_C

title: What an incredible tour,...

title: Well worth the trip.
text: Well worth the trip, however the walk to St Michael’s Cross is uphill and quite strenuous. Our guide Valeria was excellent, as was our driver.
author: Amanda_M

title: Excellent tour!
text: Very thorough tour, fabulous experience! We learned a lot and the guides were excellent! Well worth it!
author: victoria_j

title: Such a wonderful day trip!
text: You may be wondering if you want to "give up" a day of your vacation to go on this all day excursion. The answer is absolutely, yes! Monserrat is a unique and lovely place whose history is rich! Ride the funicular to the top for beautiful views, see the Black Madonna! You'll be glad you did.
author: S_R

title: We’d recommend this tour.
text: We had a great time…we departed on time and saw all the sights, but never felt rushed. Our tour guide was very friendly and knowledgeable.
